translations.web: I saw the mountains, and behold, they trembled, and all the hills moved back and forth.
translations.bsb: I looked at the mountains, and behold, they were quaking; all the hills were swaying.
translations.kjv: I beheld the mountains, and, lo, they trembled, and all the hills moved lightly.
translations.asv: I beheld the mountains, and, lo, they trembled, and all the hills moved to and fro.
